title: Nonce-Respecting MAC Security for EWCDMD
summary: The known PRF attack on EWCDMD does not readily extend to nonce-respecting forgery, leaving MAC security in that setting unresolved.

formal_statement.body: The known attack against $\mathrm{EWCDMD}$ is a $\mathrm{PRF}$ attack and does not readily extend to a forgery attack in the nonce-respecting setting. Prove $\mathrm{MAC}$ security for $\mathrm{EWCDMD}$ in that setting.

scope.domain: Security analysis of message authentication and authenticated-encryption constructions in symmetric cryptography.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove MAC security for EWCDMD in the nonce-respecting setting.

citations.label: Mind the Composition: Birthday Bound Attacks on EWCDMD and SoKAC21

progress.summary: The paper lists this question in Section 7.1, "Some Open Problems," distinguishing its PRF attack on EWCDMD from a forgery attack in the nonce-respecting setting. It identifies proving MAC security as an interesting research problem.
citation_labels: Mridul Nandi et al., Mind the Composition: Birthday Bound Attacks on EWCDMD and SoKAC21
